note: England only. The other three nations are null on purpose, not by oversight, so backdating blocks 2025/26 for them rather than estimating. Scotland: the SRA implementation review records no uplift in 2024/25 and no indication of one in 2025/26, but an absence of indications is not a published rate, so the 2024/25 figures are NOT carried forward here. Northern Ireland: a 4% uplift for 2025/26 backdated to 1 April 2025 is on record and the Department of Health has since published a 2025-26 model scheme PDF, but nobody has read the figures out of it. Wales: no Welsh Government rate table has been located for this year. See OPEN-ITEMS.md item 1b.

northern-ireland.note: Read from the Department of Health model scheme PDF, Section 1, FOSTER CARE ALLOWANCES, SCALE RATES, "From 1st April 2025". Transcribed as printed. The per-4-weeks column beside it multiplies exactly on all four rows (155x4=620, 173x4=692, 194x4=776, 228x4=912), which is the document checking itself. Uplift against 2024/25 is 4.0, 4.2, 3.7 and 4.1 per cent, consistent with the announced 4 per cent backdated to 1 April 2025. DO NOT USE the REDUCED RATES table printed beneath, which reads 112.00 / 125.00 / 140.00 / 164.00 a week, about 28 per cent lower. It covers enhanced allowances and short breaks and is not the allowance.

scotland.note: Scottish Recommended Allowance, from an archived gov.scot capture of 15 October 2025 of the page last updated 27 June 2025. Announced May 2025, backdated to 1 April 2025. The page prints 0-4 at 171.17, 5-10 at 199.14, 11-15 at 199.14 and 16+ at 272.97: 5-10 and 11-15 are IDENTICAL, which is the three-band design (0-4, 5-15, 16-17) presented across four categories to mirror what local authorities use. The table here uses the three bands. An East Renfrewshire reproduction showing 207.60 at 11-15 was wrong, and so were three of its other four figures: it was still printing 2023/24 rates. The primary source wins. Do not re-split 5-15 without a gov.scot page saying the SRA has changed shape.
